description: Election Commission - Declare that V. Anbalahan as a member of the Muthur Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Muthur Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the resignation of a member, nomination of a replacement by the group leader, and the formal declaration of the new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns the composition of an elected local government body through established electoral procedures.
